project.name: Roadmap Toán THCS
project.purpose: Hệ thống tự học Toán THCS theo mạch kiến thức dọc xuyên suốt lớp 6-9; 25 chuyên đề là Vertical Spine, KNTT là lớp mapping/định vị, đồng thời hỗ trợ luyện tập, ôn thi vào 10 và mở rộng Challenge/thi chuyên.

source_of_truth.name: Triết lý mạch kiến thức dọc
Chuẩn KNTT và các tầng học
Quy trình biên soạn và QA
Golden Template Học – Luyện – Tự kiểm tra

layers.description: Kiến thức và kỹ năng cốt lõi.
Ôn thi vào 10 dựa trên Core và dữ liệu đề thật.
Mở rộng cho học sinh khá giỏi/thi chuyên; không dùng để khóa Core.

architecture.content_pipeline: content-staging -> academic QA -> technical QA -> visual QA -> approved -> published
architecture.geometry_policy: SVG-first from verified diagram spec; semantic QA required for core geometric relations.

vertical_spine.rule: Grade/book mappings are overlays on the same knowledge graph, not separate hierarchies.

architecture.mastery_policy: soft mastery: diagnose weak prerequisites, recommend remediation, allow continued learning, and use accuracy + hint usage + history; no absolute 100% hard gate.

knowledge_graph.policy: independently reviewed; PREREQUISITE separated from SEQUENCE/CROSS_LINK/REMEDIATION; soft mastery only

ai_tutor.rule: LLM explains/guides; curriculum layer, learner evidence, reviewed graph and remediation engine remain source of truth.
ai_tutor.runtime: Tutor Context Builder + provider adapter v1; mock enabled; real providers disabled pending runtime credentials
ai_tutor.privacy: minimum relevant evidence only; no full localStorage/provider memory

learning_flow.pattern: Learn Workspace -> Practice Room -> Core Readiness Check
learning_flow.rule: Micro-practice and Practice Engine are formative; Readiness Check is after-submit assessment evidence; no hard gate.

assessment_engine.policy: after-submit only; no hints/Tutor; separate from practice evidence; READY is not Mastered

lead_on: independent solution of difficult math problems
constraints: Do not assume repository state that is not in context.
Do not mix Specialized-Challenge into KNTT-Core.
Do not self-certify high-risk geometry or advanced proofs without an independent check when feasible.
Preserve backward compatibility unless migration is deliberate.

dual_review_required_for: canonical answer keys reused across the bank
areas where prior AI answers were unstable or conflicting

current_state.practice: Practice Engine v2 active; hint engine and hint usage tracking available
current_state.geometry_qa: available with benchmark and SVG-first policy
current_state.next_priority: Run deployed Golden Template CĐ07 UX QA on desktop + iPad/mobile. If PASS, freeze Golden Template v1 and batch-rollout CĐ04–CĐ06.
current_state.grade6_mapping: reviewed and integrated as curriculum metadata
current_state.grade7_mapping: reviewed and integrated as Vertical Spine overlay
current_state.grade8_mapping: reviewed and integrated as Vertical Spine overlay
current_state.grade9_mapping: reviewed and integrated as final KNTT grade overlay
current_state.remediation_recommender: MVP implemented locally from learner evidence + Knowledge Graph v1.1; minimum-evidence safeguards enabled
current_state.remediation_loop: targeted remediation sessions implemented: 6-question local session or cross-topic focus navigation
current_state.recovery_measurement: tracks prerequisite before/after remediation and later target-skill recheck without claiming causality from one session
current_state.ai_tutor_contract: v1 provider-neutral policy defined; not yet connected to an AI provider
current_state.ai_tutor_adapter: v1 implemented with mock/local QA adapter and disabled Gemini/OpenAI-compatible transport sockets
current_state.ai_tutor_ui: mock/local Tutor integrated into Practice Engine with HINT/REMEDIATE/CONTINUE student actions; no external AI calls
current_state.ui_ux_pilot: CĐ07 five-card Learning Workspace now includes a complete 15-item inline Core micro-practice loop with shared learner evidence, option-level observed signals and mock Tutor feedback.
current_state.micro_practice_evidence: Observed signals are stored separately from attempted/correct counters. signal_weight 1–2 is salience only and cannot independently create weak-skill/remediation conclusions.
current_state.golden_template: CĐ07 Golden Template architecture independently confirmed by Gemini after PR #53. Structural implementation is dual-confirmed and QA-ready; real deployed desktop/iPad/mobile verification is the only remaining freeze gate.

do_not_assume: An AI-generated draft is not source of truth.
Difficulty is not the same as curriculum layer.
A visually plausible geometry diagram is not necessarily geometrically valid.
Exam frequency claims require evidence from an exam corpus.
A grade mapping is an index over the Vertical Spine, not a separate curriculum tree.

collaboration.relay_v2: Golden Template architecture now has independent Gemini confirmation recorded as C07-GOLDEN-TEMPLATE-CONFIRMATION-001. No additional code change required from that review.
